ctx.x: Not at all, no. There's a tendency among people to confuse the element of syncopation with Afro-American rhythms, but syncopation is an ancient musical tradition which occurs in all musical forms, and most particularly in the music of the modern European composer. Therefore, it becomes necessary to find out, well, exactly when we say jazz, exactly what is it? And one thing that it is not, or at least one thing that you can't... Uh...
